requirements.text: Implement ROR-29 stabilization on the exact clean integration baseline: finish host-observed attempt and closeout evidence; lifecycle separate from process exit; exact spec revision and Git SHA binding; reliable cancellation, retry, idempotency and isolated worktrees; productized exact-run closeout reconciliation with preview hash/expiry, immutable evidence revalidation, strict canonical path/CSRF handling, advisory-lock-safe composition, isolated reconciliation events and no ordinary execution/provider/hook/memory/delivery/merge/deploy side effects; archived pg-boss recovery semantics; reproducible Forge, public-contract, Pi Workbench, and Pi extension output; isolated test-DB authority; then prove the provider-neutral local-first default with one immutable content-addressed LocalReviewBundle and no provider or network dependency. GitHub remains an optional adapter. No autonomous merge/deploy, no rerunning passed stories, and never touch externally owned Genesis run 20260316000549. Proof run 20260316000550 may only be reconciled after reviewed merge/deploy.
